info.title: Coze Studio Knowledge Base API
info.description:
Comprehensive API documentation for Coze Studio Knowledge Base management. This API provides endpoints for managing knowledge bases, documents, and slices.

## Authentication
All endpoints require authentication. Include authentication headers in your requests.

## Base URL
- Development: `https://coze.clinx.work`
- Production: Configure according to your deployment

## Features
- Knowledge base CRUD operations
- Document upload and management (Text, Table, Image formats)
- Document processing and segmentation
- Photo management with caption support
- Table schema validation and management
- Document slicing and chunking strategies

post.description: Creates a new knowledge base with specified configuration
Retrieve a paginated list of knowledge bases with optional filtering
Retrieve detailed information for specific knowledge bases
Update knowledge base metadata and configuration

Upload documents to a knowledge base. Supports multiple formats: Text documents (PDF, DOC, TXT, etc.), Table documents (Excel, CSV), Image documents (JPG, PNG, etc.). Documents can be uploaded via local file upload (tos_uri), Base64 encoded content, Custom raw content, or ImageX URI
Retrieve documents in a knowledge base with pagination and filtering
Update document metadata and table structure
Delete multiple documents from knowledge base
Check the processing status and progress of uploaded documents
Re-process documents with new chunking and parsing strategies
Retrieve photos in an image knowledge base with filtering options
Retrieve detailed information for specific photos
Update the description/caption of a photo
Automatically generate caption for a photo using AI vision models
Retrieve table structure and preview data for uploaded table files
Validate if table schema matches the uploaded file structure
Get default icon for knowledge base based on format type
